entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables
entries.zh: 修复了在没有会话环境变量的情况下启动时云会话中报告“未登录”的`claude -p`

entries.en: Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools
entries.zh: 修复了在使用许多 MCP 工具的会话中 API 错误被“提示太长”替换以及不必要的压缩的问题
